funnel.meaning: The site is built to convert: quote form, savings calculator, named case studies. The problem is that nothing paid drives into it, so traffic depends entirely on someone already searching.

findings: No active Meta ads under your name - five Hyderabad installers (Evergrid, Solox, Truzon, Punarvi, Twilight) are live this month buying the same homeowner with the same Rs. 78,000-subsidy message.

The site claims 100+ installations, 10+ MW delivered and 500+ happy customers, with an interactive savings calculator (bill + roof size in, system size, subsidy and payback out) and three named case studies: 8 kW residential in Kondapur, 25 kW commercial at a Hanamkonda school and 50 kW industrial in LB Nagar. Trust material, already built.
Govt-empanelled vendor positioning, Tier-1 panel claims (Waaree, TATA, Adani) and full PM Surya Ghar paperwork handling - exactly the proof a homeowner wants after seeing three competitor ads.
The Hyderabad branch sits in Madhapur, right in the commercial heart of the city - but there is no Hyderabad-specific paid targeting anywhere.
Everything on the site is in English. Telugu creative is the language of the Telangana homeowner your competitors are buying.
next_steps: Test paid lead gen in Hyderabad

Test a Telugu version of the Rs. 78,000-subsidy offer against English.

The Kondapur, Hanamkonda and LB Nagar projects are named, specific and local - most competitor ads cannot show that.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
